notes.title: Sokoban-like Indie Game "Tui Shou: Sokoban" Demo Released
notes.content: [h3]About the Trial Version:[/h3][p]This app is the demo version of "Tui Shou: Sokoban". [/p][p]Players can experience the core mechanics and early main levels of the game.[/p][p]The trial version includes selected stages from the first three chapters.[/p][p]Hope you enjoy the gameplay![/p]
